 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Jayesh Yadav - G.A. for the State.

Heard on IA No.756/2025, which is first application seeking suspension of sentence on behalf of the appellant Antimbala@Janvi , who has been convicted under sections 420 and 409 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 5 years and fine of Rs.10,000/- and RI for 10 years and fine of Rs.25,000/- and under section 6 of MP Nikshepoke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000 and sentenced to undergo RI for 5 years and fine of Rs.75,000/- with default vide judgment dated 21.11.2024 in ST No.1/2017 by the I ASJ and Special Judge, MP Nikshepoke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000 Mandsaur (M.P.)
The number of persons affected are at large.

Accordingly,
present application for suspension of jail sentence of the appellant is dismissed at present.
Considering the prayer, matter be listed for final hearing in the week commencing 03.11.2025.
If the hearing is not completed for three months for no fault of appellant then appellant is having liberty to renew his prayer for suspension of jail sentence.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE ajit Antimbala@Janvi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178920935/
